passage: One especially powerful way humans adapt to their circumstances is by adjusting their behavior according to the results it produces.
A child praised by her teacher for solving a problem correctly will likely keep solving it the same way.
A dancer who feels a certain training exercise brings no progress tends to drop it for one that looks more promising.
In general, we keep doing things that bring us some benefit or help us avoid trouble and discomfort.
At the same time, we do less of, or stop, whatever leads to problems or fails to bring any reward.
choices: why children depend heavily on praise from their teachers
why dancers must follow a strict and unchanging training routine
how people adapt by changing behavior in light of its consequences
how rewards are more powerful motivators than punishments
why avoiding discomfort is the main goal of human learning
theme.explanation_ko: 인간은 자신의 행동이 낳는 결과에 비추어 행동을 바꾸며—이득을 주는 것은 계속하고 문제를 일으키는 것은 그만두며—적응한다는 내용. ③이 주제로 정답.
theme.distractor_ko: ①칭찬 의존, ②무용수의 엄격한 루틴, ④보상과 처벌 비교, ⑤불편 회피만이 목표라는 것은 본문 초점이 아니다.

passage: We should pay attention to how strongly results shape what people choose to do.
Human beings adapt above all by changing their behavior in light of the consequences it brings.
A child praised for doing an exercise correctly will keep doing it that way.
A dancer who sees no benefit from one exercise will switch to another that seems more useful.
So we should expect people to repeat what rewards them and abandon what brings only problems or no gain.
choices: 교사는 학생을 자주 칭찬하여 학습 동기를 높여야 한다.
무용수는 한 가지 훈련법을 끝까지 고수해야 실력이 는다.
사람은 보상보다 처벌에 더 민감하게 반응한다.
새로운 행동은 시도하기 전에 충분히 계획해야 한다.
사람은 행동의 결과에 비추어 행동을 바꾸며 적응한다는 점을 이해해야 한다.
claim.explanation_ko: 인간은 행동이 낳는 결과에 비추어 행동을 바꾸며 적응한다는 점을 이해해야 한다는 주장. ⑤가 정답.
claim.distractor_ko: ①칭찬 권장, ②한 훈련법 고수, ③처벌 민감성, ④사전 계획은 핵심 주장이 아니다.

passage: A particularly powerful form of human adaptation is reshaping our actions according to their results.
A child whose correct work earns the teacher's praise is likely to continue working that way.
A dancer who gains nothing from one exercise gives it up for another that looks more promising.
On the whole, we keep doing what benefits us or helps us escape discomfort.
And we cut back on or quit whatever brings problems or no reward at all.
choices: 칭찬은 아이의 학습 태도에 거의 영향을 주지 않는다.
무용수의 성공은 타고난 재능에 달려 있다.
사람은 결과에 비추어 행동을 바꾸어 가며 환경에 적응한다.
보상이 없는 행동도 습관이 되면 계속하게 된다.
사람은 불편함을 느낄 때 가장 빠르게 성장한다.
gist.explanation_ko: 이득을 주는 행동은 계속하고 문제를 일으키는 행동은 그만두며, 결과에 비추어 행동을 바꾸어 적응한다는 것이 요지. ③이 정답.
gist.distractor_ko: ①칭찬 무영향, ②타고난 재능, ④습관의 지속, ⑤불편과 성장은 요지가 아니다.

passage: Humans have a powerful tool for fitting into their world: they adjust their behavior to match its results.
A child praised for getting an exercise right will keep going about it the same way.
A dancer who finds an exercise useless will trade it for one that promises more.
Broadly, we repeat actions that pay off and help us dodge trouble.
And we give up actions that cause problems or yield no reward.
choices: The Power of a Teacher's Daily Praise
Why Dancers Never Change Their Routines
Shaped by Results: How We Adapt Our Behavior
Rewards Always Beat Punishments
Comfort: The Enemy of Human Growth
title.explanation_ko: 결과에 비추어 행동을 바꾸며 적응한다는 핵심을 압축한 ③이 제목으로 정답.
title.distractor_ko: ①교사의 칭찬, ②변하지 않는 루틴, ④보상 우위, ⑤편안함과 성장은 초점이 아니다.

passage: A powerful way humans adjust to their world is by changing behavior in light of the consequences it yields.
A child praised for an exercise done right keeps doing it that way.

every action we take has effects that are impossible to predict

order.given: A particularly powerful way in which human beings adapt and adjust to their circumstances is by changing behaviors in light of the consequences that they yield.

blocks.A: A dancer, on the other hand, who feels that a particular exercise is not giving any results is likely to give it up in favor of another one that seems more promising.
blocks.B: For instance, a child who gets praised by her teacher for doing an exercise correctly is likely to continue doing the exercise in that very way.
blocks.C: In general, then, we do more of what brings benefit and avoid discomfort, while doing less of, or stopping, whatever leads to problems or brings no reward.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 원리 뒤에 (B)가 'For instance'로 칭찬받아 행동을 유지하는 예, (A)가 'on the other hand'로 효과 없어 그만두는 반대 예, (C)가 'In general, then'으로 일반화한다. (B)-(A)-(C).
order.distractor_ko: (B)의 'For instance'가 원리를 곧장 예시화하고, (A)의 'on the other hand'는 (B)와 대비되며, (C)는 두 예를 묶어 결론짓는다.

insert.insert_sentence: A dancer, in contrast, who feels that a particular exercise is not giving any results is likely to give it up in favor of another one that seems more promising.

passage_marked.text: A particularly powerful way in which human beings adapt to their circumstances is by changing behaviors in light of the consequences they yield.
For instance, a child praised by her teacher for doing an exercise correctly is likely to continue doing it in that way.
In general, then, we tend to do things that bring us some kind of benefit or help us avoid discomfort.
We also tend to do fewer of the things that lead to problems or disadvantages.
In this way, results quietly guide which behaviors we keep and which we drop.

choices: ①
②
③
④
⑤
insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장은 칭찬받아 행동을 유지하는 예(②번 앞 문장)와 대비되는 'in contrast'의 무용수 사례이므로, 그 예시 뒤이자 'In general(일반화)' 앞인 ②에 와야 한다. ②가 정답.
insert.distractor_ko: 주어진 대비 사례가 없으면 'For instance'의 긍정 예만 남고 결과에 따라 행동을 '그만두는' 면이 빠진다.

passage: Humans adapt powerfully by reshaping their behavior according to its results.

summary.summary_template: People adapt to their circumstances by __(A)__ behaviors that bring benefits while __(B)__ those that cause problems or no reward.
summary.explanation_ko: 사람은 이득을 주는 행동은 (A)repeating(반복)하고 문제를 일으키는 행동은 (B)dropping(그만두)며 적응한다. ③.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 repeating, (B)는 dropping이어야 한다. avoiding/keeping 등은 본문과 반대이다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.

writing.answer: We tend to do things that bring us benefit.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.

writing.answer: Humans adapt by changing behaviors in light of the consequences they yield.

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 흐름상 빈칸에 들어갈 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.

writing.answer: 우리는 문제, 불편함, 또는 불이익으로 이어지는 일들을 더 적게 하는 경향이 있다.
